newsitem.title: UK: UK to keep research institutes in public sector.
newsitem.headline: UK to keep research institutes in public sector.

text.p: The government announced on Wednesday that, following a review, it had decided to keep a number of research establishments in the public sector.
Science and Technology minister Ian Taylor said seven Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council institutes should remain in public hands and retain their separate existence.
But he said he expected the BBSRC to continue to look for ways of controlling costs and contracting out support services.
Taylor said the government had concluded the three Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) establishments should also remain in the public sector with separate identities.
Separately, Agriculture Minister Douglas Hogg said the government had also decided to keep the Veterinary Laboratories Agency and Horticulture Research International in the public sector.
